mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, REQ_CAR_NO AS CAR_NO, TN.OWNER_NM, TN.BIZ_NO, TO_CHAR(REQUEST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS REQUEST_DT, pkg_common.fn_decrypt(TN.REG_NO) AS REG_NO, pkg_common.fn_decrypt(BASE_ADDRESS) AS ADDRESS, pkg_common.fn_decrypt(BASE_ADDRESS_DT) AS ADDRESS_DT, pkg_common.fn_decrypt(MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, ( SELECT CODE_NM FROM TM_CODE WHERE GROUP_ID = 'GOVT' AND CODE_ID = TS.GOVT_ID ) AS GOVT_NM, ( SELECT TO_CHAR(DSIGN_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') FROM TR_DSIGN WHERE SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND DSIGN_ST = 'END' AND DSIGN_GB = 'WSIGN' AND DSIGN_SEQ = ( SELECT MAX(DSIGN_SEQ) FROM TR_DSIGN WHERE SERVICE_ID = TS.SERVICE_ID AND DSIGN_ST = 'END' AND DSIGN_GB = 'WSIGN' ) ) AS SIGN_DT, NTAX_WHO, DEBTOR_NM, pkg_common.fn_decrypt(TOI.REG_NO) AS DEBTOR_NO, pkg_common.fn_decrypt(DEBTOR_ADDR) AS DEBTOR_ADDR, pkg_common.fn_decrypt(DEBTOR_ADDR_DT) AS DEBTOR_ADDR_DT, pkg_common.fn_decrypt(DSIGN_HP_NO) AS DEBTOR_TEL FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_OWNERINFO TOI WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TOI.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID} AND TOI.SEQ = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TR_ATTACH_FILE ( SERVICE_ID, ATCHFILEPATH_NM, ATCHFILE_NM, SEQ, ATCHSVRFILE_NM, GUBUN, INS_USER, INS_DATE, UPD_USER, UPD_DATE ) VALUES ( #{SERVICE_ID}, #{ATCHFILEPATH_NM}, #{ATCHFILE_NM}, #{SEQ}, #{ATCHSVRFILE_NM}, #{GUBUN}, #{INS_USER}, SYSDATE, #{UPD_USER}, SYSDATE )
